summary: Deschutes County, OR: 60-foot pole L-4 lookout built on Finley Butte near La Pine in 1932; removed, and the summit now holds a shed and radio gear.

facts.status_note: Tower removed; the summit is now a shed and communications site
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Deschutes National Forest

visit.trail_note: No tower to climb. A 2022 visit reached the top by the Finley Butte Road from La Pine, past a signed quarry.

events.note: Panoramic photographs taken from the site (February and June 1934)

notes_for_editor: Removal year not found in the four sources read. The access description rests on one 2022 visit report (WillhiteWeb), not a Forest Service statement, so the story gives no access level. A 1991 Deschutes NF eligibility study of its lookouts (State Library of Oregon record, https://digitalcollections.library.oregon.gov/nodes/view/275303) was found, but its text was not readable here; worth checking for the removal date. Record fields look correct.
